root.name: work
root.help:
usage: work [-h] --project-root PROJECT_ROOT [--verbose]
               {contract,paths,hierarchy,instructions,fingerprint,skills,handoff,attempt,correction,discussion,task,specification,workflow,workspace,execute,invocation,migration,delegation,source} ...

positional arguments:
  {contract,paths,hierarchy,instructions,fingerprint,skills,handoff,attempt,correction,discussion,task,specification,workflow,workspace,execute,invocation,migration,delegation,source}

options:
  -h, --help            Return command help in a JSON response.
  --project-root PROJECT_ROOT
  --verbose             Return the complete canonical success payload instead
                        of the brief projection.

arguments.name: verbose
arguments.help: Return the complete canonical success payload instead of the brief projection.
